text: Where is HTML entity reference decoding (for example &nbsp; or &#233;) actually implemented? Name the class and the method that performs the lookup, and describe how the entity table is loaded.

Trace the control and data flow from a call to Jsoup.parse(String html) to the point where the first Element is appended to the Document tree. List each class and method the call passes through, in order.

I want to add a new Safelist preset that permits <video> and <source> tags with a restricted set of attributes. Which files and methods would I need to modify or add, and what existing preset should I model it on?
How is the parser subsystem structured? Describe the roles of the tokeniser, the tree builder, and the parser state machine, and explain how HTML and XML parsing differ in that structure.

What happens when jsoup parses a document whose declared charset conflicts with the charset supplied by the caller or by the HTTP response? Identify the code that resolves the conflict and what triggers a re-parse.
